The '''Talcharaim system''' was located in the [[Interior Region]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Sivoria system/Legends|Sivoria system]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Talcharaim [[Star system/Legends|system]] shared its name with the [[Music/Legends|song]] ''[[Talcharaim Mist-Night]]''.<ref name="Journal11">{{JournalCite|11|Spare Parts (short story)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Talcharaim system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
